infra_optimization_verdict: TRAIN: baseline 23.0s/epoch -> 19.4s/epoch (batch=96+channels_last, -15.7%, VRAM 5.69GB/12GB). INFERENCE 750img: baseline b2=108.69s -> b16_save=53.79s (-50.5%). Key findings: (1) torch.compile unusable on Windows (no Triton); (2) batch scaling recovers gen time but uint8_cpu_copy is a hard 37.87s bottleneck independent of batch; (3) nosave path shifts VAE decode cost to Phase 2 (1.5s -> 30.8s), net savings only ~0.65s vs save; (4) b16_save is optimal — b16_nosave gives only 0.65s further gain. Metrics unchanged: CLIP-S=0.7261, LPIPS=0.3354.
